text: Condensed mathematics (Clausen-Scholze) uses ∞-categorical foundations. Its relationship to HoTT is that:
choices: It is formalisable in HoTT directly
It uses condensed sets which are sheaves on profinite sets, requiring (∞,1)-topos methods
It is a subfield of cubical TT
explanation: Condensed mathematics uses (∞,1)-topos methods; formalising it in univalent foundations is an active research programme.
